title: effect_pan clamps the TARGET center at the LIVE zoom — mid-ease pans converge outside the world clamp or destroy the zoom-to-point anchor
evidence:
nx, ny := rnd.camera_pan_center(app.cam_wx_to, app.cam_wy_to, dx, dy, fit, app.cam_zoom)
	 nx, ny = rnd.camera_clamp_center(nx, ny, f32(v.win_w), f32(v.win_h), fit, app.cam_zoom, v.world_w, v.world_h)
detail: The stored targets converge at cam_zoom_to but are clamped against the live cam_zoom. A drag during a zoom-out ease converges with the viewport past the world edge (paper void); near the fit the degenerate clamp range pins and overwrites an in-flight zoom-to-point anchor target.
recommended_fix: Clamp the panned target at the TARGET zoom (cam_zoom_to) in effect_pan, as camera_zoom_at already does, so the converged center is always world-valid and zoom anchors survive mid-ease pans.

title: Wheel residue advances before the ownership decision — NOC-scrolled/modal-blocked wheels pre-charge a delayed map zoom
detail: wheel_accum mutates in poll_mouse before effect_zoom's policy runs. Notches consumed as Noc_Scroll or Blocked leave fractional residue (never reset anywhere — grep: poll.odin:85 is the only write) that fires a surprise zoom notch after the pointer leaves the panel or the modal closes.
recommended_fix: Reset inp.wheel_accum to 0 when camera_wheel_policy returns Noc_Scroll or Blocked, so wheel motion consumed by another surface leaves no map-zoom debt.
